introduction: JSMacros is a Minecraft mod that allows scripting automation using JavaScript.

methods: Player.getPlayer().getPos() → Returns player's coordinates as {x, y, z}
Player.openInventory().getSlot(index) → Returns information about the specified slot (0-based index).
World.getBlock(x, y, z) → Gets block data at the specified coordinates
Chat.say(message) → Sends a public chat message
Chat.log(message) → Logs a client-side message (visible only to the user)
